sql.processStepStatus.getTypesForCompany: select * from flow.process_step_status_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.processStepStatus.getType: select id, process_step_status_type, archived from flow.process_step_status_type st where id = :typeId order by st.process_step_status_type;
sql.processStepStatus.deleteType: update flow.process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.updateType: update flow.process_step_status_type set process_step_status_type = :statusType, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
